newsitem.title: SUDAN: Sudan says army killed 24 rebels in southwest.
newsitem.headline: Sudan says army killed 24 rebels in southwest.

text.p: Sudan said its army killed 24 rebels and destroyed their bases in weekend fighting in the state of Western Equatoria, which is almost entirely controlled by the opposition forces.

"The armed forces and the People's Defence Forces have destroyed outlaw camps at Dosa area on the road to the biggest outlaw camp at Fario Sekke in Western Equatoria," state television reported late on Tuesday.
There was no independent confirmation of the attack and it is difficult to assess the accuracy of reports issued by both the army and rebels who are fighting to topple Sudan's Islamist government.

State television said the army attacked on Friday bases of the rebel Sudan People's Liberation Army (SPLA) at Dosa, killing 13 people -- including a captain -- and wounding several others. It said that the remaining rebels had fled to Fario Sekke, their main base in the area.
The television also said that the army ..."overran another outlaw camp at Bari area on Sunday and killed 11 outlaws, including two officers".
The army also seized rifles and ammunition, the television reported.

Sudan has launched a counterattack against the rebels, who started their offensive earlier this month. Khartoum says Eritrea and Ethiopia are fighting with the rebels in the south and east but both countries deny any involvment.
